background_setting: A dark two-lane rural road at night with no streetlights. The asphalt stretches ahead into blackness, marked by a faint dashed center line and edge markings. Fields, low brush, and the silhouettes of scattered trees line both sides of the road, barely visible beyond the reach of the headlights. The sky is a deep starless black. The only significant illumination comes from the ego vehicle's headlights and the oncoming truck's flashing LED light bar.

lighting.conditions: Near-total darkness pierced by intense artificial white light from the oncoming truck's LED light bar and the ego vehicle's headlights
lighting.direction: Front-lit from the oncoming vehicle's light bar and the ego headlights; harsh glare originating from center-left frame
lighting.shadows: Long, sharp shadows cast backward from roadside vegetation and road features; deep black shadows dominate the periphery
lighting.illumination_effect: Overwhelming central glare with pronounced lens flare and light bloom washing out detail near the truck, while the surroundings remain enveloped in darkness

aesthetics.composition: Centered forward-facing dashcam framing with the road converging toward a vanishing point; the glaring light source dominates the central and left portion of the frame
aesthetics.color_scheme: High-contrast palette of deep black night, cool white and blue-white LED glare, warm amber road reflections from headlights
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Tense, dazzling, disorienting yet steady and controlled
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating dashed center-line markings; radial lens-flare streaks from the light source

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking shot from the moving ego vehicle, steady with subtle road vibration; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.framing: Wide shot capturing the full road ahead through the windshield
cinematography.focus: Road ahead and approaching truck, though partially obscured by glare

context: Autonomous driving / ADAS scenario demonstrating glare-robust lane keeping past an oncoming vehicle at night

actions.description: Ego vehicle cruises forward on the dark rural road; distant oncoming truck's LED light bar appears and begins flashing brilliant white in the opposite lane. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The two vehicles close rapidly; intense glare and lens flare wash across the camera as the truck nears, but the ego lane remains clear. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

Ego vehicle holds its lane and cruising speed, passing the truck on its left without slowing; glare peaks then fades as the truck recedes behind. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego car drives forward through pitch-black countryside, its headlights sweeping the empty two-lane road as a distant bright point appears ahead in the opposite lane. By 0:01 the point resolves into an oncoming pickup truck whose high-mounted LED light bar flashes brilliant white. From 0:02 the vehicles close quickly and intense glare with radial lens flare spills across the camera, washing out the left side of the frame, yet the ego lane remains clear. Around 0:03 the glare peaks as the truck passes on the left; the ego vehicle holds its lane and cruising speed without any braking. From 0:03 to 0:05 the truck recedes behind the camera, the flare fades, and the dark road ahead reopens as the car continues driving steadily into the night. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Steady low hum of the car engine and tires rolling over asphalt, punctuated by faint wind noise. As the oncoming truck approaches, the pitch of its engine briefly rises and Dopplers past. No music or speech; ambient rural night silence dominates between the vehicle sounds.
